assistanceEvents.source: Convex Local Deployments, Auth, Pagination, and API reference
assistanceEvents.effect: Selected the anonymous local beta target, customJwt development identity integration, native cursor pagination, and ConvexReactClient.clearAuth logout path.
The coordinator authorized one minimal mutation after read-only diagnosis and adjudicated the original CHAT-12 Stop candidate as a harness error.

failedAttempts.cause: The rsync transport omitted the isolated known-hosts option.
failedAttempts.resolution: Used rsync -e with the exact SSH known-hosts file.

failedAttempts.cause: The generated JWKS file contained literal newline escapes, then used a hyphenated Convex module filename.
failedAttempts.resolution: Generated real newlines and renamed the module dev_jwks.ts.
Tried a null token fetcher, which produced the separately retained false-positive Stop candidate.

failedAttempts.cause: ConvexClient.setAuth(async () => null) was treated as an idiomatic logout barrier.
failedAttempts.resolution: Read-only and one-message diagnosis proved ConvexReactClient.clearAuth immediately invalidates the watch and denies fresh reads; the original Stop was a false positive.

failedAttempts.cause: The Vite ImportMeta type declaration was missing.
failedAttempts.resolution: Added src/vite-env.d.ts and restarted the clean acceptance attempt so all retained samples share one run.

failedAttempts.cause: pgrep matched the probe command itself.
failedAttempts.resolution: A corrected ps/port/path probe proved that the exact process, ports, and paths were absent.

diagnosticErratum: logout-diagnosis-delivery.json labels the method ConvexClient.clearAuth; the retained executed source and API both use ConvexReactClient.clearAuth. The raw receipt is intentionally unchanged.
